page.overview:
Who is Pencil Devil?

The Pencil Devil's appearance is that of a human body colored yellow with its head being a gigantic pencil tip with several eyes.

Nothing is currently known about the The Pencil Devil's personality except it presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

At one point, the Pencil Devil was causing chaos in an office building before it was eventually killed in an elevator by Public Safety Devil Hunters.

As a Devil, the Pencil Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities.
